Hi Tom — great to hear from you and thanks for the one-pager. Quick clarification: you mentioned "11:00 or 14:00" — are those CET (Berlin local) times? To avoid any mix-ups with DST and international teams, could you confirm the exact timezone? For reference, here are conversions for the two windows you suggested (assuming CET / UTC+1):

- 11:00 CET = 02:00 PT / 05:00 ET / 10:00 UTC
- 14:00 CET = 05:00 PT / 08:00 ET / 13:00 UTC

If you meant local Berlin times those conversions are correct. If you meant UTC, please say so and we’ll adjust. We have participants in PT (Karthik), ET (Marissa), and GMT+5:30 (Vivek sometimes), so explicit timezone labels are safest.

If those CET slots are the target, our internal preference would be 14:00 CET (that’s 05:00 PT / 08:00 ET) — Marissa can join at 08:00 ET. If 14:00 CET is too late for you, happy to offer other windows Thu/Fri.

Also note: US daylight savings starts mid-March, so if we schedule the week after that it shifts the PT/ET offsets by 1 hour. Let me know whether you want the invite sent with a UTC timestamp to avoid ambiguity.

I can send a calendar option with explicit UTC times once you confirm.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
